gaps_and_changes.title: Inverted score_runup Formula Turning Falling Knives into BULLISH Buys
gaps_and_changes.empirical_impact_before: 29 closed BULLISH swing trades had 20.7% win rate (6W/23L) and -50.93% cumulative PnL (24/29 were Technical Baseline).
gaps_and_changes.root_cause: np.clip(100.0 - (runup_5d * 10.0), -50.0, 50.0) awarded maximum +50.0 (+17.5 weighted pts) whenever runup_5d <= +5%, including crashing stocks (runup_5d < 0%). Combined with +3.0 pts for dist_200 > 0, falling stocks with zero news catalyst crossed final_score >= 18.0.
gaps_and_changes.change_applied: Replaced linear runup clip with directional bimodal scoring: falling knives (runup_5d <= 0.3%) receive negative bullish runup score and -0.45 logit penalty; BULLISH swing entries require +0.3% <= runup_5d <= +5.5%, vol_surge >= 1.20x, close_pos >= 55%, RSI(14) in [50, 72], and verified catalyst or strong volume surge.

gaps_and_changes.title: Static 2.5%/3.5% Stop-Losses Causing Day 1-2 Intraday Wick Whipsaws
gaps_and_changes.empirical_impact_before: 50 of 99 losses (50.5%) stopped out within <=2 days (28 on Day 1). 15 of those 50 (30%) subsequently moved >=+2% in predicted direction and 10 (20%) hit full target (e.g. COLPAL +10.58%, TRENT +8.29%, INFY +8.19%, ICICIPRULI +7.52%). Also SIEMENS and ABB 180D moats stopped out at -8% on Day 12-14.
gaps_and_changes.root_cause: Hardcoded Stop_Loss_Pct (-2.5%/-3.5% and +2.5%) ignored stock-specific ATR(14), and evaluate_trade_lifecycle checked intraday High/Low on Day 1 opening wicks.
gaps_and_changes.change_applied: Scaled swing stops to clip(2.2 * ATR_14_Pct, 3.5%, 6.0%) and targets to clip(3.0 * ATR_14_Pct, 4.5%, 8.5%). Added Day-1 Close-basis wick protection in evaluate_trade_lifecycle (intraday High/Low checked from Day 2+). Widened 180D BULLISH_CONTRARIAN catastrophe stop floor to -12.0% on closing basis.

gaps_and_changes.title: Missing 5-Day Ticker Cooldown & Repeat-Shorting Secular Momentum Compounders
gaps_and_changes.empirical_impact_before: 68 of 192 trades (35.4%) were overlapping entries on the same ticker within <=5 days. 5 repeat-shorted momentum stocks (TRENT, HCLTECH, TORNTPOWER, ICICIGI, BHARTIARTL) went 2W/23L (8.0% WR, -76.06% PnL), whereas all other 109 BEARISH_FADE trades achieved 55.0% WR (60W/49L) and +88.27% PnL.
gaps_and_changes.root_cause: audit_daemon.py only checked if today_str_Ticker existed, allowing daily re-entry on active positions and ignoring Empirical Bayes repeat-failure memory.
gaps_and_changes.change_applied: Added is_ticker_in_cooldown_or_blacklisted() in ticker_utils.py enforcing: (a) no duplicate entry if ticker has an OPEN/PENDING trade or was traded within <=5 days, and (b) hard block if Empirical Bayes ledger history has >=3 closed trades with <=25% win rate.

gaps_and_changes.title: Unbounded 'eir'/'vai' USFDA Regex Matching 'their'/'available' on Non-Pharma Stocks
gaps_and_changes.empirical_impact_before: All 6 closed 'USFDA Inspection / EIR Clearance' trades were on non-pharma tickers (TITAN, ITC, WIPRO, TCS, HDFCLIFE, TORNTPOWER) with 1/6 (16.7%) win rate.
gaps_and_changes.root_cause: Regex r'(?:usfda|...|eir|...|v-?a-?i)' lacked word boundaries (\b), matching 'their' and 'available' in generic market roundup RSS items.
gaps_and_changes.change_applied: Added strict word boundaries r'\b(?:usfda|establishment inspection report|eir|form 483|warning letter|zero observations|vai)\b' and restricted USFDA catalyst assignment to PHARMA_HEALTHCARE_TICKERS.

gaps_and_changes.title: Uncalibrated 'High'/'75%' Confidence & Missing Schema Columns in Cron Daemon
gaps_and_changes.empirical_impact_before: 149 closed rows had '75%' confidence vs 42.3% actual WR (-32.7% calibration gap), and rows 174-191 from Oct 19-28 had 'High' and NaN Market_Regime/Catalyst_Score.
gaps_and_changes.root_cause: audit_daemon.py hardcoded Confidence='High' and omitted Market_Regime, Catalyst_Score, and Remarks; catalyst_app.py overwrote 'High' with '75%'.
gaps_and_changes.change_applied: Synced audit_daemon.py to compute live NIFTY 50 regime, log Platt-calibrated f'{prob_1w}%' confidence, and write full 20-column schema; removed static '75%' overwrite in catalyst_app.py and backfilled rows 174-191.
